caption: The drawing depicts a mannequin or headless figure dressed in an elaborate historical gown. The dress has a full, floor-length skirt in a muted dark pink or rose color featuring a repeating, vertical wavy gold pattern. The fitted bodice matches the skirt and is accented by a white lace-trimmed collar and a large red bow at the neckline. Around the waist, there is a red sash tied in a bow on the left side. The figure has a matching red mitten on its left hand. Covering the head area is a blue bonnet, shaded with darker blues on the inside, and decorated with red ribbons. The background consists of a plain off-white surface with two outlined rectangular boxes in green, one behind the upper part of the figure and the other behind the lower part, both with faint lines and no filling. The lower edge and corners of the paper show slight yellowing or signs of age.
title: Doorstop (Doll)
